overview: In the Signature teaching of sheet metal work, What Sheet Metal Work Studies is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place. Layout means developing flat patterns from 3D shapes with bend allowances. Joining means rivets, spot welds, screws, and lock seams assembling parts. Joining: rivets, spot welds, screws, and lock seams assembling parts.
key_laws: Bend allowance: the developed length consumed by each bend, function of radius and thickness.
vocabulary: Gauge: the sheet thickness system, smaller numbers meaning thicker.
Cleat: the folded connector joining duct sections.
methods: Pattern development: laying out transitions, cones, and offsets true to size.
